items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: when, uh, we were with Paul Moyer's group, he had one tooth on the side.

ctx.x: Well, that's the one that I attended.

Oh, and Bunk Johnson went to Pops Foster, told me he went there, you know, George Foster, the bass player. Yes. And Emmanuel Moneta did too. He went there when he was a boy. Not long, but maybe a year or so.
Well, uh, my first school was at James Lewis School, uh, in the elementary grades, and then I finished from McDonough 35 High School and, uh, New Orleans University later. Uh.
